entries.en: Owww... This sucks... Geez, how did things[n]end up like this?
Ugh, you're so annoying. You... creepy[n]stalker!
...I hate this. I wanna go home.
Hey! That really hurt!
Ooh, what if this leaves a scar and it's[n]permanent?
Sorry...
Just get plastic surgery.
I'll take responsibility.
You know, sometimes it's nice when a[n]guy acts more aggressive, but violence[n]is just too much.
Hey, be careful, okay? My skin is all[n]sensitive...
Wait, are you doing this to get[n]my attention? Well, too bad. I'm not giving[n]it to you.
Are you stupid or something? You think I'll[n]accept your apology when you're shooting[n]at me?
Hey! I don't need that! Look at me![n]Are you blind or something?
But I heard that once you start, you can't[n]stop. How much would it cost to do work[n]on my whole body?
Oh, that's true! I also wanna get my eyes[n]and nose done... Oh! And, like, get lipo!
Hey, that doesn't solve the real problem![n]I'm talking about you! This is all your fault!
...Huh? Take responsibil— Omigod![n]We just met! We can't get married or[n]anything like that yet!
...Huh? Take responsibil— That's too fast![n]I don't hate the idea, but I can't do that.
Oh, yeah? How much will it cost to treat[n]my injuries? Your allowance can't cover[n]that.
Ugh, you're so rude. You should totally[n]be begging me, "Please let me make it[n]up to you, please."
God, that's loud! Do you know how[n]many people you're annoying with[n]all that noise?
You want to shoot me now!? You're[n]terrible at reading between the lines...
Um, you've never even spoken to a girl[n]in real life, haven't you?
Um, can't you see? I'm a girl. You're not[n]supposed to treat us like this.
Why do you carry something like that[n]with you, anyway?
You carry a gun because you think it'll[n]make you more popular with the girls?
That's right.
It won't?
It's for self-improvement.
Wait, really? Does that mean, like,[n]it really worked somewhere before?[n]Was I the wrong one here?
Uhh... Usually, that, like, totally doesn't[n]work...
Oh, I've heard about boys like you.[n]So desperate for girls to like them,[n]it's cringe-worthy...
If you wanna be popular with girls,[n]you should be nice! And spend[n]money on dates, not guns!
You're so far gone. Omigod, you must[n]think bandanas and sleeveless shirts[n]are awesome too, don't you?
Please. "I'll shoot you if you don't like me."[n]Even animals can be more romantic than[n]that.
Geez, you took the "girls like guys with[n]hobbies" thing way too far. You are one[n]really sad case.
Of course, it doesn't! How does pointing[n]a gun at girls make them like you more!?
I guess self-improvement is important[n]and all, but you are totally doing it all[n]wrong.
Whaaat? Then improve yourself with a[n]martial artist or the yakuza, not a delicate[n]girl like me.
...How is this supposed to improve you?[n]You must be the type to do real terrible[n]in school.
Uh, couldn't you just improve yourself,[n]like in your room, without bothering[n]other people?
Okay, okay, you look cool. Geez,[n]calm down.
Okay, I can see how this would appeal[n]to certain girls, but it's not, like,[n]for everyone.
Oh, no... You're completely lost in your[n]own little world.
Ugh! You must really hate listening to[n]other people! Does your family treat[n]you like this?
Hey. So this is assault, right?
...Maybe I'll call the police. Maybe I'll tell[n]'em that you were worse than you actually[n]were!
Call them. I dare you.
Forgive me.
It was self-defense.
I'm the victim here, and you're angry?[n]As if! Man... You really just don't care,[n]do you?
Yeah, they probably won't even show,[n]even if I called them. I mean, look at[n]where we are...
What? What's with your attitude? Fine,[n]YOU call them if you want them to come[n]over so much!
Fine then, I guess I'll just call them. Don't[n]come crying to me when you regret it!
Why are you scared? Duh, the police can't[n]even come here.
What? That really scares you? Heh, maybe[n]I'll call over your mom and dad too.
Are you getting all scared from hearing[n]the word "police"? That is so lame,[n]you know.
Maybe you shouldn't have done[n]something like this in the first place!
You can say that when you're up against[n]gross monsters! Hurting cute girls like me[n]can get you the death sentence!
You would claim self-defense against[n]a little girl like me...? Ugh, you're so lame...
Even still, don't you think you're overdoing[n]it?
You know, I can totally do the same and[n]say it was self-defense too.
If we do get to see the police, I'll tell them[n]about that shot just now.
This is definitely "attempted murder"![n]How scary!
Wow... You actually shot at me...
Ah, never mind! I won't call the police![n]In fact, they probably can't even come[n]here!
...Don't tell me you're going to shoot that.[n]You're not really gonna do that to me,[n]are you?
Hey, how about this? If you don't shoot me,[n]then I'll kiss you. Not a bad deal, right?
Not a bad idea.
I don't want a kiss.
Have some self-respect.
Just admit that you're happy about it![n]Ugh, what a downer. Never mind, I take[n]it back.
...On second thought, that mask you're[n]wearing might hurt my face.
Huh? Don't you know how valuable[n]my kiss is? Aw, now I don't feel like[n]doing this anymore.
...Hold on, now that I think about it,[n]this isn't an even trade. I take it back.
Please, I wasn't going to force you.[n]What's up with you!?
Ohhh, you don't know how, do you?[n]You don't have to say it...
What? Take your mask off and get over[n]here! I'll give you a kiss that'll give you[n]nightmares!
Ooh, look at you, getting bashful. Your[n]face must be all red under that mask!
...What? Are you saying that to be nice?[n]We're trying to kill each other, and[n]you're being nice?
Shut up! Who do you think you are?[n]If you want to live life like it's a teen movie,[n]do it somewhere else!
You took it seriously? Omigod! I don't go[n]around just kissing anybody, you know.
You don't need to tell me! I'm cute,[n]so of course I have self-respect!
What the hell? Is this like when a little kid[n]hits you because he's feeling shy? This is[n]a bit much.
Whoa... A kiss isn't enough? Don't you[n]think you're hoping for a little too much[n]from me?
Wow, isn't that kind of rude? You're not[n]just gonna hurt me, you're gonna hurt my[n]feelings on top of that... Are you serious?
Careful! If you hit my lips, you'll ruin[n]my best feature!
Hmmm? There's something about the way[n]you smell... Oh, I see...
It's hard to tell under the mask, but...[n]you're actually handsome, aren't you?
How did you know?
No, not at all.
I look okay, I guess.
Hm. Why are you wearing a mask, then?[n]I think you're bad at marketing yourself.
Ohmigod! Are you really that confident?[n]That's hilarious!
Oh, so you easily admit it? That's okay.[n]I think I get what kind of person you are[n]now.
You can say that after you take that mask[n]off! There's no way for me to judge before[n]that!
Well, looks aren't that important for a guy.[n]What's in your heart is more important...[n]and what's in your wallet.
Huh, so you're treating me like this,[n]and you're not even handsome?[n]Well, this is a letdown.
At least you're better than all those ugly[n]people who are overconfident.
Really? Well, maybe I thought that[n]because of your eyes. Hey, you got[n]that going for you.
That sort of modesty is the kind that the[n]most arrogant people use. You should[n]cut that out.
Gross. Not openly admitting it makes[n]you seem more like a narcissist. That's[n]annoying!
Sounds like false modesty to me. Are you[n]sure you're not just really conceited?
Oh, yeah? I'm going to warn you, my[n]standards for "okay-looking" are also[n]pretty high.
I'm not sure if your reaction meant[n]"Shut up," or "Of course, I am"!
You know, your looks, the way you're[n]built, it's not bad. Your personality,[n]though...
What? Do you think I pose a threat to you[n]right now? I don't move THAT fast!
...This isn't even a conversation! Your[n]communication skills could really use[n]a bit more work.
Oh! The hem on your long coat is[n]really cute!
Is it only for men? Where did you get it?
Do you want it?
Internet shopping.
It's not available for sale.
I don't want that, but I AM interested in the[n]brand.
Actually, I don't like it that much. Never[n]mind.
Huh? Really? Wait, but that one's for guys.[n]I don't want it anymore.
Ew, not the one YOU'RE wearing!
Internet shopping's the best, and it's all[n]delivered to you. I'll check it out if I get[n]back home.
Geez, you must have searched the[n]internet for a long time to find this.[n]Do you not have friends?
I get scared, though, of my private info[n]getting leaked and stolen online.
Isn't internet shopping shady, though?[n]Foreign companies sell fakes a lot,[n]don't they?
So, what? You were just wearing it without[n]realizing it? You need to get better at lying.

Are you mean to me since I was interested[n]in it? Hmph, I wanna kill you now for being[n]so douchey!
What? So this was handmade? No way![n]How good with your hands are you!?
You want to keep it a secret that much?[n]Not let your favorite obscure shop go[n]mainstream?
If you don't want to tell me that much,[n]I won't ask anymore. It's not like I care[n]or anything.
It doesn't take a lot to set you off, does it?
This is what I get for trying to be nice[n]to you? Ugh, that's so annoying.
So... Is this it for me? But, I'm still so young.
Hey, if I don't die here... What do you think[n]I'll be like in the future?
A fashionable older woman.
I can't measure that.
Living in darkness.
Well, yeah. I'm totally on the right[n]track too, and I have high standards[n]for makeup and fashion.
I still wanna be pretty, even when[n]I'm older. It takes time and money[n]to keep looking beautiful, though.
The future seems so far off, it's hard[n]to imagine. And thinking of me as[n]an old woman is scary...
Shoot, I'd rather not age at all. Some older[n]fashionable ladies look great, but they still[n]look olddd.
You're just saying that 'cause you can't[n]think of anything else, huh?
Sooo... You're basically saying that you're[n]not capable of measuring me?
Right? My potential knows no limits!
Aw, c'mon! That's when you have to try[n]your best to measure it!
Shut up, don't decide for me! This is ME[n]you're talking about!
Well, yeah... if I give up here, that's what'll[n]happen. I'll have to keep my spirits up!
Living in darkness? Like, the nightlife?[n]I could see myself working as a club[n]hostess.
...Hey, if my future's in darkness, wouldn't[n]that all be your fault?
Are you... Are you trying to encourage me?[n]I think I see... It's all over if I give up.
You want me to... look forward? Look[n]forward instead of looking back. I guess[n]you're right.
All right, you're not in the mood for[n]chitchat. I'll stop.
Gah, stop! Just let me think for a moment,[n]dummy!
...Why me, though?
I'm sure there're other people in the[n]world who'd irritate you more. C'mon,[n]tell me.
Older people trying to look young.
No one bothers me.
I hate everyone.
Whaaat? Really? Is it really so bad if[n]someone wants to feel young again?
Totally! I really wish they'd, like, dress[n]appropriately for their age or something...
You know you're gonna become an old[n]man too, someday.
Oh! I totally get that! Like, duh, a cute[n]outfit's not gonna fool anyone.
Yeah, seriously! Everyone has quirks![n]But it's way better to be BFFs!
...As if! Why are you totally doing this[n]to me then!?
Ooh, what a great outlook on life![n]People can't live alone, after all.
You totally piss me off!
...Did something happen to you? If your[n]mom heard you say that, she'd be really[n]worried.
Yeah, I get you. Why would you want to be[n]in a world if you're not the center of it?
I know how you feel. Sometimes, I feel[n]that everyone but me is a total idiot.
Hey, that view is a bit too extreme.[n]Maybe you play too many video games.
So wait, it's me who specifically irritates you?[n]I dunno. Sounds like love to me!
Hey, who let you hold a gun, anyway?[n]I want to speak to your manager.
Hey, anyone would be irritated at[n]someone who shoots instead of talking[n]like a normal person.
Why don't you try using words to express[n]how I irritate you? Could you not talk with[n]your gun?
All right, I get it. You didn't really mean[n]to approach me, right?
When it came right down to it, you[n]couldn't do anything to me!
I could.
How could you tell?
What do you want me to do?
Then do it.
Awww, are you protesting because I hit[n]a sore spot? Haha, this is totally going[n]nowhere.
Ooh, liar liar pants on fire! That line was[n]so not cool!
Talk is cheap!
I guess you could call it a girl's intuition?
Of course I could! I'm totally experienced,[n]after all.
Oh, you were actually serious...? I see...
...Huh? I mean, look at this situation.[n]This is so not cool.
Well... shouldn't you be the one to[n]lead me?
C'mon, at least, like, try and guess what[n]I might want!
...Can you let me go?
Yikes! Asking that totally makes you[n]sound like an old geezer!
Trying to prove me wrong? That's kind[n]of annoying...
Fine, I get it! I guess you just do things[n]at your own pace.
Are you the type that wants to prove[n]people wrong when you think they're[n]underestimating you?
Are you the type to use violence instead[n]of talking like a normal person?
Anyway, I'm so angry right now. It looks[n]like my fortune was right.
My horoscope said I was gonna have[n]"relationship difficulties" today.
Looks like it came true.
It's just a horoscope.
How is your luck in romance?
Tell me about it... Ugh! My financial luck[n]is totally awful, too!
Why is it, like, always the bad stuff that[n]comes true...
Well, I guess it's better than being alone?
Are you making fun of me? Ugh, you're so[n]not cool!
I guess it's pretty open-minded to not[n]blame anything.
Shut up, I don't want a lecture from you[n]right now!
...Hey, but this is your fault!
I get it, like, mentally, but emotionally?[n]I can't handle it.
You mean... because I met you?
I think my love life is pretty good...[n]I think...
Ugh, romance is a pain. I'm sooo taking[n]a break right now from all that.
You think that makes me feel better?
You're right. I mean, if I met a weirdo[n]like you...
...Hey, do you have a problem?
Ugh, forget "difficulties"! This is straight[n]up bad luck!
...Maybe you've got personality problems,[n]but it's, like, kind of good that you just[n]take action.
...Hey. Aren't you hungry?
Can we take a break and go eat[n]somewhere?
What're we getting?
Yeah.
Now's not the time.
Isn't the guy supposed to decide that?
We can pick something together.
I want something fried!
What, you think I'm gonna eat you? As if!
Nice! C'mon, let's go!
Okay! Where should we go?
Oh, but we probably have different tastes,[n]so maybe not.
Wait, I don't have any money on me.[n]That's too bad...
Then maybe I'll just eat you instead... JK!
Ughhh, you're no fun.
Don't be like that! I wasn't serious, geez.
Then we'll just go once we're done here.
Oh, I get enough iron from taking[n]supplements...
Ooh, this smokiness... Makes me think[n]about fried rice or barbecue...
Okay, I guess we could order something[n]and have it delivered?
If you're not hungry, just say so!
Oh crap! Today's the day of the event![n]I hope tons of hotties show up.
What do you think I should wear? I admit[n]it, I wanna draw some attention to myself.
High school uniform.
Kimono.
Don't wear anything.
Wait, what? Do you have a thing for school[n]uniforms? That's hilarious!
No, I wouldn't stand out. Too many girls[n]will already be dressed like that.
Yeah, but I think a lot of girls will show up[n]wearing that.
Ah, that's the gold standard, huh?
I didn't think of that. I guess I'd look pure[n]and innocent, too. Guys really like that...
Whaat? Won't that make it hard to dance[n]and eat and drink?
Whaa—? Would a kimono even look good[n]on my body type?
I gotcha. Japanese-style stuff is pretty[n]popular all over the world, after all.
Uh, no. There's, like, no way I'm not[n]gonna wear clothes.
Guys are all the same when it comes to[n]that stuff, huh? You're so funny!
Like a nudist? I can't do that!
Shut up, I've been eating too many snacks[n]lately, so... even if I wanted to, I couldn't!
Oh? You're telling me to add some blood[n]to my costume? That's a pretty good idea!
Hey, watch it. What if I get holes in my[n]clothes?
...I think I get it. It's better to force guys to[n]look my way than to try to cater to their[n]tastes.
Save that for the club! You'd really get the[n]crowd hyped with that kind of energy!
Why are you so interested in me, anyway?
I'll go out with you just for today if there[n]are no strings attached.
If it pleases you.
No strings attached?
I've got enough on my plate...
Oh, no, it should be me who should be[n]saying that...
Oh, wow, looks like you've got some[n]manners after all.
Uh, wow... Do you actually go out with[n]people that easily?
You nervous? Well, I didn't expect that.
What? You saying one day's not enough?
Yup. Only for today.
It doesn't matter how it goes in the[n]beginning. What matters is what[n]happens next.
Don't make me say it so many times!
Hey! I'm doing you a favor! You better[n]accept and say yes!
That's rude! Especially since I made[n]the first move here!
Ohh, are you the type that would do this[n]kinda stuff with anyone?
Oh, please, don't fake it. You're all alone[n]when you get home, am I right?
Heh. I guess that gunshot's signaling the[n]beginning of our relationship.
You already trying to establish dominance[n]in this relationship?
How annoying... If you're not interested,[n]just say so.
Not interested in a date, huh?
You know, if you wanted to take me[n]somewhere, I'll go with you.
It's no fun going home when only my[n]annoying mom and dad are there.
Parents are annoying.
You should love your parents.
Why not come to my place?
Well, they're not all bad... Ah, forget I said[n]anything.
Yeah, they just don't get that things are[n]different from when they were my age...
Yeah, but you check up on them when[n]you don't hear from them or they seem[n]unwell, right?
Yeah, well, watching them cry is totally[n]annoying too.
...I know, but the way they say things[n]is annoying.
I'm more independent than they think!
I know that!
I don't understand why they have to get[n]on my case, though!
Uh, I think I'll pass. We're not even that[n]close...
Oh, let's! Wait, maybe I should take this[n]more seriously...
Whoa, hold on... I know exactly what you're[n]trying to do...
When you say that while pointing a gun[n]at me, it makes me feel like you're gonna[n]kidnap me...
Okay... I won't say something like that again.
Ah! If I die, you're gonna make my[n]mom cry!
Ah! If I die, my dad's gonna faint from[n]shock!

...Ugh, this is getting to be a drag.
We'll just say you win. So can we stop this?
I feel bad.
I don't agree with this.
Everyone wins.
Don't worry, I don't mind.
I mean, this started as a simple[n]misunderstanding, after all...
I knew you were a smart human.
Seriously. It hurt a lot!
Shut up. You won, and that's what matters.
Gah, so annoying. You won. Who cares?
No need to agree. You won!
Who cares? It's the results that matter,[n]not feelings.
I don't care about winning, just cut it out...
That's true. I guess it doesn't matter who[n]wins and who loses...
Is this supposed to be like a participation[n]trophy from elementary school?
Uh, what? That doesn't make any sense.
What the hell? You want something more[n]than a win?
All right, you shot your gun. Satisfied?
Ugh, I can't hang around you forever.

Oh, I totally forgot to reply to my[n]messages. It'd be a pain if they get[n]pissy about this...

Sometimes.
No.
I have no friends.
Totally! Isn't it so great to have friends[n]that will support you?
For sure, I totally get how you feel. It's so[n]hard to be popular.

Really? You're getting on my nerves.
Then, you should totally come hang out[n]with me! We could be friends!
Huh? Uh... Well... Sorry...
Wow, you didn't hesitate one bit when[n]you said that!
I understand. I don't have any real[n]friends either.
I guess even other humans can't[n]understand your charm. Or I should say,[n]lack of charm.
Are you trying to tell me not to talk bad[n]about your friends?
Oh, I wasn't talking bad about your[n]friends.
Ugh, it's annoying that you're shooting[n]bullets like this instead of just talking[n]to me.

Hey, is this all a game to you?

That's right.
I choose my targets carefully.
I'm serious about this.
Right? And I'll totally break your front[n]teeth if you do it again.
Well, I know you're not a bad kid,[n]deep down inside.
One wrong move, and I could have been[n]killed!
Maybe it's a little late for you to realize[n]that, but... Oh, well.
That's called playing favorites!
You have to be smart to survive in this[n]world.
Ugh, I dunno. Your strategy sounds pretty[n]lame to me.
...Yeah, well, if you chose me, you chose[n]pretty badly.
Omigod, he thinks video games and real[n]life are the same...
So, like, the more fun you can have in this[n]world, the better, huh?
Like I care! Whatever! I don't care[n]anymore!
Wait, are you serious...? Are you stupid?
Ah, that sort of grazed me... I think?
Missed. You're a terrible shot.
This place isn't real life, so if you really[n]wanted to shoot me, you probably could.
You think it's funny when people don't[n]like what you're doing, don't you?

Nothing wrong about it.
What's the right way, then?
I'm not hitting on you.
Oh... So this is a thing that happens[n]sometimes?
I guess. Yeah, you can't stand out by doing[n]the same thing as everyone else.
What, no, it's totally wrong. Omigod,[n]you're weird.
Does this mean I'M weird?
I don't know. I don't hit on guys.
Um, you're the one hitting on me. Isn't it[n]stupid to ask the person you're hitting on?
Ah, maybe you've a point. What is the[n]"right" way, anyway?
Ugh, this is what the internet is for![n]Look it up!

If you're not, you really came to kill me,[n]right?
Then, what are we doing here? I so want[n]to go home already.
Uhh, you're obviously hitting on me.

Hey, maybe I'm not falling for you, but[n]that doesn't mean you can go ahead and[n]shoot me.

You're right.

Right? So why don't we come to an[n]agreement?

It's a little late for realizing that, dummy!

I'm not talking about anything[n]complicated like that. I just want[n]to live, dammit!
Why do you care about that? That's a[n]stupid question.
Um... Humans?
It doesn't matter how real they are,[n]an enemy's an enemy!
So you really wanna kill me. At least[n]you're consistent.
Like I said... There's no point in killing me.

...Oh. Yeah... I didn't take a bath yesterday.
Hey, is my hair flat? Does it look weird?
It looks cute.
It's weird-looking.
Who cares?

I know. I have some self-awareness,[n]you know.

Are you serious... It's just hair, so you[n]should be okay with it.
